knowledge_graph.title: First Choice MRI Center
knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "The MRI Center at First Choice Neurology is located at 9085 SW 87 Avenue, Suite 200, Miami, Florida 33176. Call 786-219-3145 to make an appointment. We have board-certified Neuro-Radiologists or Orthopedic Radiologists interpreting and reporting. An MRI is an important tool to help your doctor make an accurate diagnosis. The MRI consists of two parts: the image and the read. It is critical that the image quality be high so that it can be properly interpreted. It is also critical that the read be accurate and complete."

posts.description: An MRI is an important tool to help your doctor make an accurate diagnosis. Our MAGNETOM Lumina MRI is a state-of-the-art 3T Large Bore system designed to deliver exceptional imaging and patient comfort. It features advanced BioMatrix technology, which automatically adapts to each patient’s unique physiology for more precise scans. Combined with the powerful syngo MR XA software platform and the exclusive Turbo Suite, the MAGNETOM Lumina transforms the MRI experience by enhancing image quality, streamlining workflows, and improving overall care delivery.
